claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tiaprofenic acid is a COX-inhibiting NSAID with no cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak, non-selective NSAID-associated membrane/oxidative stress rather than a specific killing mechanism.
